'''Sibyl''' was the [[Zeltron/Legends|Zeltron]] wife of [[Demagol]]. She lived at some point between the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] and the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. She became involved in Demagol's research, the goal of which was to create [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] children at his [[New Generation Academy|school]] on [[Osadia]]. The two eventually had a daughter, named [[Chantique]]. Wyrick, however, was more interested in the Force-attuned [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]] offsprings than in his own daughter. Seeing her as a failure, Wyrick willingly gave Chantique to [[The Crucible]], a [[Slavery/Legends|slaving]] organization. The grief of losing her daughter caused Sibyl to commit [[Death/Legends|suicide]].
